en: Black‑and‑white streetscape of a European town around the early 20th century. A broad avenue lined with multi‑storey, late‑19th‑century buildings is filled with pedestrians, a horse‑drawn vehicle and an early electric tram. Some shop awnings extend over the sidewalk. On the hill in the background stands a large complex with a central tower, resembling a monastery or institutional building, surrounded by forest. On the nearest corner building a sign on the gable reads "VILLA PETRUSKA", and on the corner building further down the street a sign reads "ALLIANZ". Another shop sign at street level reads "KARL KLOIBER".
